conflicts.permit: We may charge you for our reasonable costs in supplying you with access to this information.
conflicts.prohibit: You will not have to pay a fee to access your personal information (or to exercise any of the other rights).
conflicts.situation: When a user submits a routine, legitimate request to access the personal information held about them.
conflicts.reason: One section allows charging reasonable supply costs generally, while the GDPR section explicitly states no fee is required unless the request is unfounded, repetitive, or excessive.
